$comment: The names that were once Words and must stay unknown. A retired name returning is a vocabulary decision, and this file records the decision rather than freezing the first one made: UNIQUE was cut in the phase-1 freeze as one of several overlapping collection Words and came back on its own terms (a contract, a law witness, a conformance case); REPLACE came back in the vocabulary-100 work order's Phase 3 as INDEX-OF's substitution counterpart for Text; CEIL came back in Phase 1 as the closure of the rounding family and went again in the minimal-core cut. Two gates read this file: scripts/check-minimal-core.mjs asserts no name here is canonical in spec/words.json, and rust/tests/beta_removed_words.rs asserts the runtime, the compiled path and the host lookup all report each name as an Unknown Word. A group's optional phrases map a name to one runnable line of current Ajisai that does what the name did; rust/src/diagnostic_hint.rs appends it to the Unknown Word diagnosis for that name, and rust/src/diagnostic_hint_tests.rs runs every phrase and asserts it names only canonical Words.

groups.reason: The alpha Words the phase-1 vocabulary freeze retired.

phrases.SIGN: -5 'X' BIND 0 -1 1 X 0 LT SELECT X 0 EQ SELECT
phrases.INSERT: [ 1 3 ] 'V' BIND V 1 TAKE [ 2 ] V 1 DROP CONCAT CONCAT
phrases.REMOVE: [ 1 2 3 ] 'V' BIND V 1 TAKE V 2 DROP CONCAT
phrases.STARTS-WITH?: 'hello' 'he' SEARCH 'I' BIND FALSE I 0 EQ I NIL? SELECT

groups.reason: Retired after the vocabulary-100 work order's review (2026-09, §7.2; the alpha adoption rule that governed the swap is docs/dev/ajisai-minimal-core-identity.md Appendix B): NEQ is `EQ NOT` at the same cost, and PROBE was CONTRACT over a block. The two slots went to UPPER and LOWER, the top of the waiting list.

The minimal-core cut: each a phrase over what remains rather than a capability. NEG is `-1 MUL`, DEFINED? is `CONTRACT NIL? NOT`, RANK is nested MAPs (and MAP took its Kernel seat), ANY/ALL are MAP then a FOLD of the truth values, `a b LTE` is `a b GT NOT`, OR is De Morgan over AND/NOT, RANDOM a user-written generator; OR LTE GTE CEIL QUANTIZE ABS MOD were the derivable Standards no program in the lexicon pilot (tools/lexicon-emergence/runs/pilot-2026-09-23) wrote once.

phrases.OR: TRUE 'A' BIND FALSE 'B' BIND A NOT B NOT AND NOT
phrases.QUANTIZE: 7/3 'X' BIND 1/4 'Q' BIND X Q DIV ROUND Q MUL
phrases.MOD: 10 'X' BIND 3 'Y' BIND X X Y DIV FLOOR Y MUL SUB

groups.reason: Went with the computable-real tier they alone built: each answered a value no comparison could always decide, so the numeric domain is now the exact field SQRT builds and comparison is total.
Folded into GET and PUT: reading and writing a Record by key is what reading and writing a Vector by index is, so one pair of Words covers both containers, and PUT took WITH's Kernel seat.

Gave their slots to the four-valued truth domain (2026-10): BOTH and RECONCILE took the head of the retirement queue in scripts/check-minimal-core.mjs. Both were derivable Standards with no recorded use: INDEX-OF is a first match over GET and EQ, and MEMBER? the same chain answering a truth value.

The three-valued downgrade (2026-10): the truth domain is SQL's strong Kleene logic, TRUE, FALSE and UNKNOWN. BOTH was Belnap's fourth value; two sources that disagree on a truth value now meet as any two disagreeing values do, in NIL(conflict), whose reason keeps what BOTH said. See docs/dev/three-valued-truth.md.
